posts.text:
I am deeply saddened by the sudden passing of Senator Lindsey Graham.

Lindsey dedicated his entire life to serving this country—both in the U.S. Air Force and in Congress.

He was an incredibly effective lawmaker who always led with courage and deep conviction. He always did what he thought was right even if it wasn’t popular, leaving behind a massive legacy of leadership that won't be forgotten. 

Erika and I send our prayers to Lindsey’s family and the people of South Carolina. 

May he rest
posts.summary: Praises Senator Lindsey Graham's legacy and service

Today, I met Ada.

She told me she's supporting me because she knows I'm ready to serve our great state.

I'm humbled to have earned her support, and I'm grateful she's already cast her vote.

Now it's your turn. Make a plan to vote early or get out and vote on Election Day. 🇺🇸

posts.text:
It was an honor to meet Eraise today in Westchester. 

Eraise spent 12 years as a political prisoner in Cuba before he found freedom in Florida. 

Stories like his are why this state matters so much to so many people. I'm grateful for his trust and honored to have earned his vote today.
posts.summary: Emphasizes Florida's importance to Cuban political prisoners

posts.text:
Enjoyed spending the afternoon at Mitch’s Downtown in Hallandale Beach for Bagels with Byron.

Thank you to everyone who joined us for a thoughtful Q&A on lowering costs, growing our economy, and ensuring Florida remains the best place to start a business, raise a family, and live the American Dream.

posts.text:
I am honored to earn the endorsement of the @FloridaChiefs.

Every day, Florida's law enforcement officers put on the badge and risk their lives to protect our families and our communities. 

As Governor, I will always stand with those who serve, ensure they have the resources they need to do their jobs safely and effectively, and continue building on Florida's reputation as the safest and most law-and-order state in America.
posts.summary: Pledges support for law enforcement and resources

posts.text:
Incredible afternoon in Panama City with @ErikaDonalds. There's nothing like talking with Floridians who love this state as much as we do.

I'm running so the families who built Florida can still afford to live here, surrounded by the Florida they grew up in, with beaches and clean water protected for the next generation.

That's the Florida Dream and it's worth defending.
posts.summary: Frames campaign around protecting Florida's beaches and affordability

posts.text:
Stopped by Uncle Ernie’s Seafood in Panama City to talk to some local folks who had to rebuild everything following the devastation Hurricane Michael.

We agreed about the need for drastic permitting reform that lets folks build FAST — a key part of my platform. That goes hand-in-hand with improving the insurance market.

I also heard from a server at the restaurant that President Trump’s No Tax On Tips has been an absolute game-changer!
